Port Gellhorn a connu son heure de gloir: Port Gellhorn had its glory days as a beach resort; only the signs are left. Rockstar describes a city that has lost its prosperity, with its cheap motels, abandoned malls and closed-down attractions, where you can lie low and take the jobs nobody else wants. In the official screenshots, the neon of the Starlet Motel and late-night bars towers over a backdrop of roadside shops and vacant lots. It’s a forgotten coast, the exact opposite of Vice City’s glitz. Trailer 1 puts Jason and Lucia’s motel room there.
Le premier trailer y situe la chambre de: Trailer 1 puts Jason and Lucia’s motel room there; the Extended Look comes back to it.
Grassrivers est l’équivalent des Evergla: Grassrivers is Leonida’s version of the Everglades: a huge subtropical wetland of mangroves, slow canals, flooded plains and cypress trees. Rockstar describes it as the state’s untamed jewel, as beautiful as it is dangerous, where alligators are the most famous attraction and where you mostly get around by airboat. Hunting, fishing and poaching sit side by side with wildlife protection units. The official screenshots show a police chase through the swamps, stilt buildings and mud-covered locals posing with their catch on an airboat. It’s home turf for the Airboat 09 and the Vortex, and proof that you won’t explore the map only by car.
Rockstar présente Grassrivers comme la p: Rockstar presents Grassrivers as the largest subtropical wilderness in the country and as an untamed jewel: alligators, airboats, hunting and fishing, poachers and wildlife protection. The official screenshots show a pickup chase through the swamps, locals posing with their catch on an airboat, stilt buildings and two men on an airboat surrounded by alligators.
Bae-Luxe et Roxy sont les visages musica: Bae-Luxe and Roxy are the musical faces of Vice City in the official images: studio, microphone, convertible, a show on the hood of a car. Rockstar presents them through their path, from dealing to viral tracks, and their bet on landing another hit five years after the first. They’re the only duo among the characters.
Les captures officielles les montrent en: The official screenshots show them in the studio, at the microphone, putting on a show on the hood of a car and at the wheel of a convertible with Dre’Quan. Their page links to Only Raw Records and Dre’Quan Priest.
Stock 305 est une boutique de vêtements: Stock 305 is a clothing store whose sign is spelled out in full in Rockstar’s official screenshots. Its graffiti-covered front and painted interior walls make it one of the most recognizable shops in Vice City; the images show Jason sitting on the roof of a painted van outside the store, Lucia leaning against it, then each of them inside. The Ultimate Edition presents it as Stockyard’s premier streetwear address, only open with that edition. The name refers to the area code of Miami, the city Vice City is based on. Its catalog and prices will be added with the game.

Sara’s Unisex Salon est le salon de coif: Sara’s Unisex Salon is the hair and nail salon Rockstar shows in its official gallery. The screenshots show Jason and Lucia outside the storefront, Jason with the salon’s mullet and Lucia getting a manicure, a sign that hair and beauty salons are back like in previous games. The Ultimate Edition promises signature hairstyles for both, facial hair for Jason, makeup and nails for Lucia. The salon is marked on the Vice City map thanks to the official screenshots. The available haircuts and their prices will be documented after release.

Electric Fang Tattoo est le salon de tat: Electric Fang Tattoo is the tattoo parlor in the Stockyard neighborhood of Vice City, shown in the Ultimate Edition artwork. Its sign, a red neon wolf, dominates the front of the building, where two motorcycles are parked. The screenshots show Jason and Lucia outside the parlor, Lucia with a buzz cut under a tattoo artist’s needle and Jason with a fully inked back: tattoos are back as a way to customize the characters. Brian Heder est un trafiquant de la viei: Brian Heder is an old-school trafficker, shaped by the golden age of smuggling in the Keys. Rockstar describes him as a Leonida beach bum with the bite of a great white shark: long enough in the business to let others do the dirty work. He still moves his goods through his boatyard, with Lori, his third wife. He lets Jason live for free in one of his properties, as long as he helps with local debt collection and stops by for Lori’s sangria. In his view, nothing beats a Mudslide at sunset. The screenshots show him riding with Jason, leaning on a railing, holding a package in a plane and handing Jason a pistol.
Dans le second trailer, Brian est le pat: In Trailer 2, Brian is Jason’s boss: he’s the one who sends him out to collect, and Jason’s day starts in front of his boatyard. The screenshots show him in a car with Jason, leaning on a railing, and handing Jason a pistol in front of a pickup. Rockstar ties him to the golden age of smuggling in the Keys, which makes him the old-world character set against Jason’s and Raul’s ambitions.
Les captures officielles le montrent pas: The official screenshots show him riding with Jason, leaning on a railing with two cans, holding a package in a plane, and handing Jason a pistol in front of a pickup. His page links to the Caracara 4x4, the boatyard spotted on the map, his house in the Keys, Jason and Cal.
Raul Bautista est un braqueur de banques: Raul Bautista is an experienced bank robber who relies on confidence, charm and cunning. Rockstar describes him as always on the lookout for talent ready to take the risks that pay off the most, and warns that his recklessness raises the stakes with every score: his crew will have to keep up or bow out. Experience counts, says his official introduction. The screenshots show him on the phone in front of screens, behind the wheel of a car with a custom pistol, and on the deck of a boat facing the towers of Vice City. He’s the one who brings Jason and Lucia into the most ambitious scores.
Raul est le braqueur du récit : celui qu: Raul is the story’s bank robber: the one who recruits, plans and pushes the others to take risks. The official screenshots show him in a light-colored suit on a neon-lit street, on the deck of a boat, on the phone in front of screens, and behind the wheel, pistol in hand. His introduction casts him as the driving force behind the big scores, with a warning from the studio about his recklessness: he’s the one raising the stakes for Jason and Lucia.
